verdict.rationale: The only direct evidence is one line on the Agent Readiness overview saying a designer can share a mockup and the system implements it. That line reads more like an aspirational outcome than a documented attachment workflow. Design mode (selecting an element and describing a change) is a related but different feature and is not credited. Missing for 10: documented support for attaching images or screenshots to a task or session, support for marked-up or annotated screenshots specifically, details on how the agent interprets visual input, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can attach a marked-up screenshot or mockup to a task so the agent implements the correct visual change

citations.quote: A designer shares a mockup, and the system implements it without handoffs.
